questions.question: В DeFi platform design, DEX TWAP oracle используется Lending module для price feeds. Какой cross-module integration risk?

options.text: TWAP не может использоваться для lending
DEX pool manipulation → distorted TWAP → unfair liquidation. Mitigation: multi-source oracle (DEX TWAP + external feed), staleness check, deviation alert
Lending и DEX не должны интегрироваться

questions.explanation: Cross-module dependency: if DEX pool is low-liquidity, price can be manipulated → TWAP distorted → lending liquidation triggers unfairly. Mitigation: 1) Multi-source (DEX TWAP + Pyth), 2) Deviation check (reject if sources diverge > 5%), 3) Min liquidity requirement for oracle pool, 4) Staleness check.
